apps.name: Terraria
apps.subtitle: The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep
apps.localizedDescription:
The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

Terraria offers more than ever - including the brand new 1.4.5 Bigger and Boulder Content! 



Presenting an impressive catalogue of 5,000+ items, 25+ NPCs, and 400+ enemies and blending elements of classic action games with sandbox-style creativity, Terraria is truly a unique adventure!



The latest content update includes: 



NEW 1.4.5 CONTENT:

- Dead Cells crossover content – new weapons, combat accessories and more!

- Iconic Pals from Palworld have arrived in Terraria!

- Fifteen new furniture sets. 

- Five new types of boulders — watch your step!

- Four new transformation mounts.

- New whips and Summoner prefixes. 

- New Kites, critters, and decorative features. 

- And so much more to discover! 





NEW WORLD SEEDS TO DISCOVER:

- A new Skyblock world seed.

- A new world creation menu allowing you to mix and match special seeds.

- Improvements to existing seeds!



IMPROVEMENTS:

- Reworks and balance improvements to weapons. 

- Visual updates to many classic sprites.

- And so many more improvements!



• MULTIPLAYER – Play with up to 7 friends on Local Wifi or Online via device-device Wifi hosted games or through the Mobile Terraria Dedicated Server for PC (available for free on Terraria.org)

• TERRARIA REIMAGINED FOR MOBILE – Fully customizable controls and User Interface provide a level of polish and capability not previously possible!

• Gamepad support – including fully-remappable buttons - Play with your Bluetooth connected gamepad where supported.

• Full array of World sizes – Small/Medium/Large...the same size as on Terraria for PC! Now includes random world name generator and the ability to use World Seeds (including some hidden easter egg worlds)

• Over 400 enemies to combat, defeat, and plunder for loot

• Over 20 Biomes and Mini-Biomes to explore, both above and underground – from lush forests to barren deserts to dungeons, the underworld, and even the terrifying Corruption await!

• Updated crafting with multiple added item options

• Over 20 NPCs to discover, each providing their own benefits and unique style

• More than 1000 new items to discover – bringing the total item count to more than 5000!

• In-depth building options that are easy to learn but allow for amazing feats of architecture in the hands of a master.

• And much, much more!



In short, every pixel of Terraria has been reimagined and hand crafted for the BEST possible mobile experience!

apps.localizedDescription:
Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.

**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**

**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**



---



BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:



■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm



■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way



■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from



■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates



■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests



■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure



■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside



■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal



■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on iOS with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines



■ Continue farming from where you last left off with auto-save (even if you close the app!)



■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen and virtual joystick



■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...



---



“The best version of Stardew Valley is the one you have with you … This game is absolutely incredible, and will not disappoint.” - TouchArcade



"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN



“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb



"Village life has never been so accessible and satisfying" - The Telegraph



“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine



---



Note: Features new 1.6 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.



*All accolades belong to the App Store version of Stardew Valley, except for the following, which belong to the original title: Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award, BAFTA Games Award nomination, and comments by Giant Bomb and the Telegraph.

apps.localizedDescription:
free paid app ----- Alpin Quest PRO is a professional GPS and field GIS application developed for military personnel, geologists, surveyors, foresters, mountaineers, hunters, and off-road drivers. Import paper maps to your device and track your precise location offline in the field.

MAPS

• Satellite, topographic, hybrid, and street maps; contour lines and shaded relief

• Named peaks, mountain passes, water sources, and rivers

• MGRS and UTM kilometer grids; scale lock capability (e.g., 1:25,000)

• Real-time terrain type, slope, and elevation data



IMPORT CUSTOM MAPS

• GeoPDF (ArcGIS, QGIS, stand maps), GeoTIFF, MBTiles, GeoPackage

• KMZ overlay layers and multi-level large KMZ archives

• Shapefile (ZIP), KML/KMZ vector files, Memory-Map (.qct), AlpineQuest AQX

• Image with world file: PNG, JPG, TIFF with PGW, JGW, TFW

• Collar clipping (hide white borders), transparency adjustment, and layer ordering



OFFLINE FUNCTIONALITY

• Download current screen view, selected map areas, or route corridors

• Automatic caching of visited locations

• Full functionality without cellular network coverage



COORDINATE SYSTEMS (19)

• MGRS, UTM, USNG, WGS84, DMS, DDM, Plus Code, QTH

• ED50, CK-42 / SK-42, BNG (OSGB), India Grid, NSF LCC, Lambert Maroc

• Gauss-Krüger Argentina, Arc 1960, RSO Malaya, SAD69

• Simultaneous coordinate display across all systems with one-tap copy

• Magnetic declination (NOAA WMM), true, magnetic, and grid north; degrees or mils



WAYPOINTS & TARGETS

• Unlimited waypoints, photo attachments, categories, and quick search

• Manual coordinate entry and waypoint averaging for maximum accuracy

• Live distance, bearing, and estimated time of arrival (ETA)

• Customizable label positions: top, bottom, left, right



ROUTES & TRACK RECORDING

• Point-to-point, freehand drawing, or finger-traced route creation

• Auto-routing optimized for walking, driving, and hiking

• Elevation profiles with real-time ascent and descent metrics

• Continuous background track recording with speed and distance statistics

• Off-route proximity alerts



3D TERRAIN

• Review routes and tactical areas overlaid on real 3D terrain elevation



AREAS & DRAWING

• Polygons, circles, and rectangles; precise area and perimeter calculations

• Map-based reshaping, vertex editing, and splitting

• Geology rock hatch patterns; freehand sketch and text annotations for briefings



PROJECTS (GIS) & TEAM MODE

• Consolidate waypoints, routes, areas, and custom maps into unified projects

• Export to KML, KMZ, GPX, Shapefile, and UTM Shapefile

• Team Mode: Share project data with team members and track team positions live



AR & WATCH INTEGRATION

• Augmented Reality (AR) camera view identifying surrounding peaks and passes

• Apple Watch bearing guidance and compass navigation



FIELD TOOLS

• Proximity alarm: alerts when approaching target points

• Photo coordinate and direction stamping

• Weather forecasts: hourly and 7-day outlook, sun/moon phases and rise/set times

• Battery-optimized tracking profiles

• Volume button zoom control for gloved use

• Gridded PDF map export (A4, A3)

• Interactive walkthrough tutorial



FILE SHARING

• Import: GPX, KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, DXF, Shapefile

• Export: GPX, KML, KMZ, CSV, Shapefile, GeoPDF, GeoPackage

• Direct opening from WhatsApp, Mail, and the Files app

apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project’s ongoing fixes and enhancements.

These sources are intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

Choose the source variant that matches how you sideload:

• Standard: full app bundle with Apollo’s working extensions plus Apollo-Reborn widgets
• No Extensions: strips app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage on free Apple IDs
• GLASS: adds the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch and bundled Liquid Glass icon catalog
• No Extensions + GLASS: combines both options

The extension-bearing builds (Standard and GLASS) register about 7 App IDs, one per bundled app extension. A free Apple ID can register 10 App IDs per 7 days, so a clean single install fits, but it is easy to exceed if you install under more than one bundle ID, reinstall within the same week, or sideload other extension-bearing apps. If an install fails with an App ID error, use a No Extensions build (1 App ID) or wait for older App IDs to expire. A paid Apple Developer account has a much higher cap.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.
